_doc: Nova Plaza (LEVELS[5], planet 4) greybox, BS_LEVELS §4. Frame: metres, north = -z, y up. Boxes are centre + size. Flags without a dot are level-local (BS flag 'nova_plaza.<name>'); flags with a dot are global. Generic rows (boxes, signs, gates, lamps, switches, triggers, NPCs, relays, rules, collectibles) are built by the LevelDirector; the 'nova' table by bs/world/nova/nova_builder.gd. Source refs: buildNewPlanet L10345, novaDress L10446, NOVA_CFG L10518, addWalkway L17901, addUpdraft L8939, placeCore/collectCore L10300-10345, populateLife (i === 5).
name: NOVA PLAZA

boxes._: GROUND (top 0) around the service trench (x 20..42, z -88..-76: the kill plane under the broken spur)
HOA perimeter wall, 20 m (the city rim)
FOUNTAIN PLAZA (hub): paving, landing pad, ship, welcome arch, squatter bench, vending machine, valve box, pump-room shed
CIVIC CENTER (top 4.5): block, City Hall, statue, planters, west steps, sealed cache (S1), station ramp + platform
HOA DISTRICT: lower terrace (top 6), upper terrace (top 9), streets, connectors, ramps, roundabouts, hedges
HOA Clubhouse (x -36..-24, z -74..-66): open front, counter, rules board, roof (gold 1 at 14.6), pump closet, server closet
THE UNDERPASS: camp under the highway (cardboard homes, soup line), annex gate, slabs, lift, wall-kick shaft, plaza, updraft vault
PERMIT OFFICE in the old Consumption Zone mall: apron (top 3), facade with the sign strip + ledge (gold 2), floor with the basement hole, walls, roof, mezzanine, up-ramp
hall: stanchion rails between the lanes (1.0 m: jumpable, but jumping on a walkway is a violation), counter, dispenser
cleaning-bot closet (memo 20) under the mezzanine; the Cancellations Department (S3) sealed in the north-east corner
records hallway outside the mall (x 44..52, z -104..-73): block (top 9), walls, roof, columns every 8 m, plating at the far end
roof perch (S2): a billboard frame on the mall roof
TRANSIT LOOP: hub station (deco), spur root + catwalk from the FineTree deck, the broken spur, the dead train (S4) on its pillar in the trench
FINETREE DECK (top 12) over the plaza's south edge; ramps down (beyond the gate), the exit stairs (open after the kill)

lights._: few omni lights (neon, fountains and lamp posts carry the rest)

rails._: golden ride-rails (markers in group 'rails' for a later rail system). The source's left-district rail; the Transit Loop maintenance ring is built by the nova table.

gadget_points._: markers for gadgets earned elsewhere (Glide pennant at the spur root, S4)

switches._: S7 pump-room wax seal (Magma throw); S6 the clubhouse's dead fuse box (Thunder throw)

gold_bolts.how: HOA Clubhouse roof (source left gold (-30, 11, -66)): Tether-Hook along the lamp posts
THE CONSUMPTION ZONE sign strip (source right gold (34, 5, -66)): ventilation updraft, then the ledge
S1 sealed cache under the Civic Center's west steps (source pocket A): slide under the lip
S4 the dead train on the broken spur: Glide from the spur root (8 m drop over 22 m)

memos.where: FineTree Plaza, at the south fine-o-meter kiosk (pre-fight side)
Civic Center station, at the AIR — PEAK PRICING vending kiosk
S3 the sealed Cancellations Department (Grind Soles up the tube rails)

triggers._: TRANSIT LOOP: novaLate rides past the FineTree LIVE screen on the west side
OUT OF BOUNDS quips (BS_LEVELS §4.12); cooldown 20 s

rules._: the clubhouse rules board: violate all three rules in front of the three lawn Eyes

secrets.name: Sealed cache under the Civic Center
The fountains' pump room
secrets.reward: nanocrate + the Squatter's spare bench cushion

boss._doc: The Algorithm (BS_ENEMIES §4.4) via EnemySpawner.spawn(&'the_algorithm', arena.boss_spawn(), parent, {'arena': FineTreeArena}); a TestDummy stand-in (stand_in_hp) when the id is missing. phases: arena-side actions at the boss's HP thresholds.

cutscenes._doc: Nova-only cutscene scripts (same step format as cutscenes.json; '<anchor>Pos([..])' uses story.anchors). novaIntro here replaces the line-only scene with a deck camera; its lines are the original ids.

nova._doc: Built by bs/world/nova/nova_builder.gd. hoa: the violation system (BS_LEVELS §4.5). walkways: 9 (2 Civic ramps, 5 in the take-a-number hall, 2 on the FineTree ring inside 'arena'). loop: ring point = (cx + rx sin t, y, cz + rz cos t).

hoa._src: BS_LEVELS §4.5: Eye cone 14 m / 40°, red flash 1.0 s, reverse 6 s, cooldown 8 s, blind 20 s

towers._: the twin gateway skyscrapers (22 m cyan, 26 m pink) framing the hub's north exit

tower_fields._: backdrop districts: lit-window towers (8-18 m, source novaTower) filling the city around the playable spokes

homes._: identical HOA smart homes (lower terrace y 6, upper y 9), each FINED and VACANT

fountains._: the hub's central fountain (water type; memo 19 at its valve box)

highway._: the elevated highway at +14 m (novaDress arrival) with neon silhouette traffic (ambient)

walkways._: Civic Center ramps (the source's two walkways, pushing north/up)

lamp_posts._: smart lamp posts: Tether-Hook points (ring 7 m up), 10-12 m apart; the HOA chain L1-L4 is the high route to the clubhouse roof (gold 1)
Transit Loop: tether posts beside the two broken maintenance-rail spans (ring at 13 m)

eyes._: the clubhouse rules board: one Eye per rule

updrafts._: the source's right-side updraft (r 3, h 12, force 30) as a ventilation shaft beside the Permit Office (gold 2, S2)

arena._doc: FineTree Plaza (BS_LEVELS §4.10). Local frame: origin = plaza centre on the floor; see the contract at the top of bs/world/nova/finetree_arena.gd.

core._: the Keystone Core behind the server wall (arena Core marker); hidden until the Algorithm falls

quest_items._: q4b chips at the BS_LEVELS §4.8 spots
